def build_roads(input_layer, output_path):
    buffered = processing.run("native:buffer", {"INPUT": input_layer, "DISTANCE": 25, "SEGMENTS": 8, "DISSOLVE": False, "OUTPUT": "TEMPORARY_OUTPUT"})["OUTPUT"]
    dissolved = processing.run("native:dissolve", {"INPUT": buffered, "FIELD": [], "SEPARATE_DISJOINT": False, "OUTPUT": "TEMPORARY_OUTPUT"})["OUTPUT"]
    processing.run("native:savefeatures", {"INPUT": dissolved, "OUTPUT": output_path})

def build_roads(input_layer, output_path):

def inspect_layer(layer):
    provider = layer.dataProvider()
    fields = provider.fields()
    return [(field.name(), field.typeName()) for field in fields]
